headline: Fisherman's Row Brisk as Shelf and Expanse Cool
war_summary: Since the previous edition, Stlican Shelf and the Weathered Expanse have gone quiet at the map-room level, recording no ownership event in the latest two-hour window. Their twenty-four-hour ledgers remain heavy—47 and 45 changes, respectively. Fisherman's Row now shows the liveliest six-hour work, with 14 ownership events in that window and 27 over the day. Godcrofts has also stayed active, marking 12 events in six hours and 28 in twenty-four. Stonecradle has produced no ownership event in the latest six hours, but its casualties remain high and enlistments are accelerating around a three-Warden/six-Colonial split. Linn Mercy, Callahan's Passage, and Mooring County each recorded recent six-hour changes as well. The larger war remains undecided: neither faction yet holds the thirty-four victory towns needed for conquest.
